NLCT.description: Nonlinear Analysis Control Data (NLCT). A single global record (key 1); ITERATION_METHOD selects the global solution scheme (NEWTON/ARC/DISP) and controls which scalar fields apply, while the per-load-case item arrays NEWTON_ITEMS, ARCLEN_ITEMS and DISPCT_ITEMS carry the method-specific control data.

NONLINEAR_TYPE.description: Nonlinear type. Case-insensitive. "GEOM" = geometric nonlinear, "MATL" = material nonlinear, "GEOM+MATL" = geometric and material nonlinear.

ITERATION_METHOD.description: Global iteration method. Case-insensitive. "NEWTON" = Newton-Raphson, "ARC" = Arc-Length, "DISP" = Displacement-Control. Determines which of the method-specific scalar fields below apply.

OPT_ENERGY_NORM.description: Whether the energy norm convergence criterion is active.

OPT_DISPLACEMENT_NORM.description: Whether the displacement norm convergence criterion is active.

OPT_FORCE_NORM.description: Whether the force norm convergence criterion is active.

NUMBER_STEPS.description: Number of load/displacement steps for the global iteration method.

MAX_ITERATIONS.description: Maximum number of iterations per load step for the global iteration method.

INITIAL_FORCE_RATIO_ARC_LEN.description: [ITERATION_METHOD=ARC] Initial force ratio for the unit arc-length.

MASTER_NODE.description: [ITERATION_METHOD=DISP] Master node number for displacement control.

DIRECTION.description: [ITERATION_METHOD=DISP] Master node displacement direction. 0 = Dx, 1 = Dy, 2 = Dz.

NEWTON_ITEMS.description: Per-load-case Newton-Raphson control data. On PUT the existing Newton list is fully replaced by this array.

ITERATION_METHOD.description: Iteration method for this item. Case-insensitive. Should be "NEWTON".

LCNAME.description: Static load case name this control data applies to.

NUMBER_STEPS.description: Number of load steps for this load case.

MAX_ITERATIONS.description: Maximum number of iterations per load step for this load case.

ARCLEN_ITEMS.description: Per-load-case Arc-Length control data. On PUT the existing Arc-Length list is fully replaced by this array.

ITERATION_METHOD.description: Iteration method for this item. Case-insensitive. Should be "ARC".

LCNAME.description: Static load case name this control data applies to.

INITIAL_FORCE_RATIO_ARC_LEN.description: Initial force ratio for the unit arc-length.

NUMBER_STEPS.description: Maximum number of increment steps for this load case.

MAX_ITERATIONS.description: Maximum number of iterations per increment step for this load case.

DISPCT_ITEMS.description: Per-load-case Displacement-Control control data. On PUT the existing Displacement-Control list is fully replaced by this array.

ITERATION_METHOD.description: Iteration method for this item. Case-insensitive. Should be "DISP".

LCNAME.description: Static load case name this control data applies to.

NUMBER_STEPS.description: Number of displacement steps for this load case.

MAX_ITERATIONS.description: Maximum number of iterations per increment step for this load case.

MASTER_NODE.description: Master node number for displacement control.

DIRECTION.description: Master node displacement direction. 0 = Dx, 1 = Dy, 2 = Dz.

MAXIMUM_DISPLACEMENT.description: Maximum displacement of the master node.

LOAD_FACTORS.description: Master node displacement per step (index = step).
